title: Evaluating Local Language Model Agents for Reproducible Data Engineering: An Empirical Software Engineering Study of Mobility Workflows
title_zh: 评估本地语言模型智能体在可复现数据工程中的应用：一项关于移动工作流的实证软件工程研究

paragraphs.en: Context: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as software and data-engineering assistants, yet evidence about locally deployable open-weight agents remains limited. Existing evaluations often emphasize textual responses, isolated code generation, or generic tool calls rather than the validity of complete engineering artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 背景：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被用作软件和数据工程助手，但关于可在本地部署的开放权重智能体的证据仍然有限。 现有的评估通常侧重于文本响应、孤立的代码生成或通用工具调用，而非完整工程产出的有效性。

sents.en: Context: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used as software and data-engineering assistants, yet evidence about locally deployable open-weight agents remains limited.
sents.zh: 背景：大型语言模型（LLM）智能体正越来越多地被用作软件和数据工程助手，但关于可在本地部署的开放权重智能体的证据仍然有限。

sents.en: Existing evaluations often emphasize textual responses, isolated code generation, or generic tool calls rather than the validity of complete engineering artifacts.
sents.zh: 现有的评估通常侧重于文本响应、孤立的代码生成或通用工具调用，而非完整工程产出的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Objectives: We evaluate whether local LLM agents can produce correct and reproducible data-engineering artifacts, quantify the effect of a closed-loop workspace condition, and examine trade-offs involving model scale, architecture, quantization, runtime, tool use, and failure behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 目标：我们评估本地 LLM 智能体能否生成正确且可复现的数据工程产物，量化闭环工作空间条件的影响，并研究模型规模、架构、量化、运行时、工具使用及故障行为之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Methods: We introduce a benchmark of fifteen tasks using mobility workflows as a domain-grounded testbed. Tasks cover data discovery, connector construction, transport-feed processing, semantic enrichment, feature engineering, validation, visualization, and reporting. Deterministic checkers assess generated scripts, tables, structured files, figures, and reports. Ten local model configurations are evaluated in one-shot and closed-loop workspace conditions, with five repetitions per model, mode, and task, yielding 1,500 scored attempts on a consumer-grade GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 方法：我们引入一个包含十五项任务的基准测试，使用移动工作流程作为基于领域的测试平台。 任务涵盖数据发现、连接器构建、运输流处理、语义增强、特征工程、验证、可视化和报告生成。 确定性检查器用于评估生成的脚本、表格、结构化文件、图表和报告。 十种本地模型配置在单次尝试和闭环工作空间条件下进行评估，每种模型、模式和任务重复五次，最终在消费级 GPU 上获得 1,500 次评分尝试。

sents.en: Methods: We introduce a benchmark of fifteen tasks using mobility workflows as a domain-grounded testbed.
sents.zh: 方法：我们引入一个包含十五项任务的基准测试，使用移动工作流程作为基于领域的测试平台。

sents.en: Tasks cover data discovery, connector construction, transport-feed processing, semantic enrichment, feature engineering, validation, visualization, and reporting.
sents.zh: 任务涵盖数据发现、连接器构建、运输流处理、语义增强、特征工程、验证、可视化和报告生成。

sents.en: Deterministic checkers assess generated scripts, tables, structured files, figures, and reports.
sents.zh: 确定性检查器用于评估生成的脚本、表格、结构化文件、图表和报告。

sents.en: Ten local model configurations are evaluated in one-shot and closed-loop workspace conditions, with five repetitions per model, mode, and task, yielding 1,500 scored attempts on a consumer-grade GPU.
sents.zh: 十种本地模型配置在单次尝试和闭环工作空间条件下进行评估，每种模型、模式和任务重复五次，最终在消费级 GPU 上获得 1,500 次评分尝试。

paragraphs.en: Results: Among models larger than two billion parameters, the workspace condition increases pass rates by 26.7–52.0 percentage points over one-shot generation. The strongest configuration reaches 85.3% artifact-level success. A quantized 9-billion-parameter model reaches 69.3% with an approximately 6.5 GB memory footprint. Gains are largest when intermediate artifacts expose errors that the agent can inspect and repair.
paragraphs.zh: 结果：在参数规模超过20亿的大型模型中，工作区条件使通过率相比单次生成提升了26.7至52.0个百分点。 最强配置实现了85.3%的产物级成功率。 一个经过量化的90亿参数模型在约6.5 GB内存占用下达到了69.3%的成功率。 当中间产物暴露出智能体能够检查并修复的错误时，性能提升最为显著。

sents.en: Results: Among models larger than two billion parameters, the workspace condition increases pass rates by 26.7–52.0 percentage points over one-shot generation.
sents.zh: 结果：在参数规模超过20亿的大型模型中，工作区条件使通过率相比单次生成提升了26.7至52.0个百分点。

sents.en: The strongest configuration reaches 85.3% artifact-level success.
sents.zh: 最强配置实现了85.3%的产物级成功率。

sents.en: A quantized 9-billion-parameter model reaches 69.3% with an approximately 6.5 GB memory footprint.
sents.zh: 一个经过量化的90亿参数模型在约6.5 GB内存占用下达到了69.3%的成功率。

sents.en: Gains are largest when intermediate artifacts expose errors that the agent can inspect and repair.
sents.zh: 当中间产物暴露出智能体能够检查并修复的错误时，性能提升最为显著。

paragraphs.en: Conclusion: Local open-weight agents can support a meaningful subset of software-intensive data-engineering work, but their reliability depends on model capability, task verifiability, and deterministic validation. The benchmark provides a reproducible method for evaluating complete agent configurations before they are adopted in engineering workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 结论：本地开放权重智能体可以支持软件密集型数据工程工作的一个有意义的子集，但其可靠性取决于模型能力、任务的可验证性和确定性验证。 该基准测试提供了一种可重复的方法，用于在将完整的智能体配置应用于工程工作流程之前对其进行评估。

sents.en: Conclusion: Local open-weight agents can support a meaningful subset of software-intensive data-engineering work, but their reliability depends on model capability, task verifiability, and deterministic validation.

paragraphs.en: Keywords: large language model agents, empirical software engineering, data engineering, artifact validation, reproducibility, local language models
paragraphs.zh: 关键词：大型语言模型智能体、实证软件工程、数据工程、产物验证、可重复性、本地语言模型

paragraphs.en: Artifact checks evaluate local LLM agents on 15 data-engineering tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 工件检查用于评估本地大型语言模型智能体在15个数据工程任务上的表现。

paragraphs.en: Closed-loop workspaces improve pass rates by up to 52 points.
paragraphs.zh: 闭环工作空间可将通过率提升高达 52 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The strongest local configuration reaches 85.3
paragraphs.zh: 最强的本地配置达到了 85.3

paragraphs.en: Execution traces expose reliability, latency, and failure trade-offs.
paragraphs.zh: 执行轨迹揭示了可靠性、延迟和故障之间的权衡。

paragraphs.en: Large language models (LLMs) have become software-engineering assistants for activities such as code generation, code review, data preparation, validation, and documentation [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] . Their engineering value, however, depends on more than producing plausible text or isolated snippets. A generated script must execute, a structured file must satisfy its schema, and a derived result must remain consistent with its inputs. These requirements shift evaluation from response plausibility toward the validity of the engineering artifacts produced by the model.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）已成为软件工程领域的助手，能够协助完成代码生成、代码审查、数据准备、验证和文档编写等活动 [ 1 , 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] 。 然而，其工程价值并不仅仅取决于能否生成看似合理的文本或孤立的代码片段。 生成的脚本必须能够执行，结构化的文件必须符合其模式定义，而派生出的结果也必须与输入保持一致。 这些要求将评估的重点从响应的合理性转向了模型所生成的工程成果的有效性。

paragraphs.en: When an LLM is embedded in a system that can plan, inspect a workspace, invoke tools, observe execution results, and revise its outputs, it is commonly described as an LLM-based agent or tool-using language model [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] . Recent software-engineering research has begun to examine multi-agent generation of structured requirements and the validity of artifacts produced under different agent configurations [ 9 , 10 ] . Nevertheless, evidence remains limited for complete, locally deployable agent workflows evaluated through heterogeneous artifacts rather than a single code-generation task.
paragraphs.zh: 当一个大语言模型（LLM）被嵌入到一个能够规划、检查工作空间、调用工具、观察执行结果并修正其输出的系统中时，它通常被称为基于 LLM 的智能体或工具使用型语言模型 [ 6 , 7 , 8 ] 。 近期的软件工程研究开始探索多智能体生成结构化需求的过程，以及在不同智能体配置下所产出成果的有效性 [ 9 , 10 ] 。 然而，目前关于通过异构成果而非单一代码生成任务来评估完整且可本地部署的智能体工作流程的证据仍然有限。

paragraphs.en: Hosted frontier models are useful capability baselines, but many public-sector, research, and engineering organizations also need deployment options that keep data within organizational boundaries and provide control over model versions, inference settings, availability, and cost. Local open-weight models offer these properties, but their smaller size and quantization may affect their ability to operate a workspace reliably. An empirical assessment must therefore consider not only final correctness, but also model scale, resource use, interaction behavior, and failure modes.
paragraphs.zh: 托管的前沿模型是实用的能力基准，但许多公共部门、研究和工程组织也需要能够在组织内部保留数据，并对模型版本、推理设置、可用性和成本进行控制的部署方案。 本地开放权重模型具备这些特性，但其较小的规模和量化处理可能会影响其可靠运行工作空间的能力。 因此，经验性评估不仅要考虑最终的正确性，还要考虑模型规模、资源使用、交互行为以及故障模式。

paragraphs.en: Data engineering provides a software-intensive setting for this assessment. Constructing a data workflow involves programming, schema conformance, testing, provenance, domain rules, validation, and reproducible reporting. Mobility workflows are a particularly useful testbed because they combine statistical indicators, catalog records, public-transport feeds, geospatial points of interest, executable transformations, and derived analytical artifacts. Correctness requires both general engineering behavior and domain-specific care, including preserving provenance, filtering decoy records, handling GTFS service-day times beyond 24:00:00 , computing geospatial distances in meters, and avoiding unsupported claims in reports.
paragraphs.zh: 数据工程为本次评估提供了一个以软件为核心的环境。 构建数据流涉及编程、模式合规性、测试、来源追溯、领域规则、验证以及可复现的报告生成。 移动性流程是一个尤为有用的测试平台，因为它结合了统计指标、目录记录、公共交通数据流、地理空间兴趣点、可执行转换以及衍生出的分析成果。 正确性既需要通用的工程实践，也需要针对特定领域的细致处理，包括保留来源追溯信息、过滤虚假记录、处理超过 24:00:00 的 GTFS 服务日时间、以米为单位计算地理空间距离，以及避免在报告中提出无法证实的断言。

paragraphs.en: This paper presents a reproducible benchmark and controlled empirical study of local LLM agents as data-engineering assistants. The fifteen tasks follow five stages of a mobility workflow: discovering and connecting to data, processing public-transport feeds, enriching records with semantic data, engineering features and analytics, and validating and reporting results. Each task specifies input fixtures and expected output artifacts. Deterministic checkers then parse, execute, compare, or inspect those artifacts against schemas, domain rules, numerical constraints, and report requirements. The harness records success, failure category, runtime, and tool interaction, enabling the study to examine both artifact validity and the engineering behavior that precedes submission.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一项可复现的基准测试，并对本地 LLM 智能体作为数据工程助理进行了受控的经验研究。 这十五项任务遵循移动工作流程的五个阶段：发现并连接数据、处理公共交通数据流、用语义数据丰富记录、构建特征与分析模型，以及验证和报告结果。 每项任务都明确了输入测试用例和预期的输出产物。 随后，确定性检查器会解析、执行、比较或检验这些产物是否符合模式、领域规则、数值约束和报告要求。 该测试框架会记录成功与否、失败类别、运行时间以及工具交互情况，从而使得研究能够同时考察产物的有效性以及提交前所采用的工程行为。

paragraphs.zh: 一个基于实际领域的工件基准，具有固定的组件、确定性的检查器、机器可读的轨迹以及公开的复现包。

paragraphs.en: A controlled study of one-shot and closed-loop conditions across ten local model configurations, fifteen tasks, and five repetitions per condition.
paragraphs.zh: 一项受控研究，考察了单次尝试和闭环条件下十种本地模型配置、十五项任务以及每种条件下的五次重复表现。

paragraphs.en: Empirical evidence about artifact correctness, task verifiability, model scale, architecture, quantization, latency, tool interaction, and failure behavior, with implications for validating LLM-assisted engineering workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 关于人工制品正确性、任务可验证性、模型规模、架构、量化、延迟、工具交互和故障行为的实证证据，以及对验证大型语言模型辅助工程工作流程的影响。

paragraphs.en: The evaluation is organized around four research questions:
paragraphs.zh: 评估围绕四个研究问题展开：

paragraphs.en: How does artifact success differ between one-shot generation and a closed-loop workspace condition in which a local LLM can inspect inputs, execute code, and revise its artifacts?
paragraphs.zh: 在一次性生成与闭循环工作空间条件之间，人工制品的成功表现有何不同？在闭循环条件下，本地 LLM 能够检查输入、执行代码并修订其人工制品。

paragraphs.en: What level of artifact correctness and reliability do locally deployable open-weight models achieve on the mobility data-engineering tasks?
paragraphs.zh: 本地可部署的开放权重模型在移动数据工程任务中能达到何种程度的工件正确性和可靠性？

paragraphs.en: How do artifact success, runtime, and tool interactions vary with model size and architecture, and what engineering trade-offs emerge?
paragraphs.zh: 随着模型规模和架构的变化，人工制品的成功率、运行时间和工具交互方式会发生怎样的变化？又会带来哪些工程上的权衡？

paragraphs.en: How do task success and computational efficiency differ between aggressive post-training quantization and unquantized BF16 for the model sizes available in both formats?
paragraphs.zh: 对于两种格式都支持模型规模而言，激进的后训练量化与未量化的 BF16 在任务成功率和计算效率方面有何不同？

paragraphs.en: The experimental scope is deliberately restricted to models that can be served on a single 24 GB consumer GPU. This keeps the study aligned with locally controlled engineering environments and permits a controlled comparison of model scale, architecture, and precision within one serving stack. The benchmark is also intended as a reusable evaluation instrument: future agent configurations can be assessed under the same fixtures and checkers, while organizations can substitute representative local tasks before adopting an LLM-based engineering assistant. The benchmark does not claim that mobility tasks cover all software or data-engineering practice; rather, they provide a heterogeneous and reproducible testbed for studying artifact-producing agent workflows.
paragraphs.zh: 实验范围被刻意限制在能够部署于单个 24 GB 消费级 GPU 上的模型。 此举使研究保持与本地受控的工程环境一致，并允许在同一服务堆栈中对模型规模、架构和精度进行受控比较。 该基准测试也旨在成为一种可重复使用的评估工具：未来的智能体配置可以在相同的设施和检查器下进行评估，同时组织在采用基于 LLM 的工程助手之前，可以替换为具有代表性的本地任务。 该基准测试并不声称移动性任务涵盖了所有软件或数据工程实践；相反，它们提供了一个异构且可复现的测试平台，用于研究能够生成成果的智能体工作流程。

paragraphs.en: This paper studies locally deployable LLM agents as software and data-engineering assistants, with success measured from reproducible artifacts rather than textual plausibility. We therefore connect research on LLM-assisted software engineering with work on agents, executable benchmarks, tool-use evaluation, efficient local inference, reproducibility, and open mobility data.
paragraphs.zh: 本文研究了可本地部署的大型语言模型智能体，将其用作软件和数据工程助手，其成功与否通过可复现的成果来衡量，而非文本的合理性。 因此，我们将大型语言模型辅助软件工程的研究与智能体、可执行基准、工具使用评估、高效的本地推理、可复现性以及开放移动数据相关的工作联系起来。

paragraphs.en: A first strand of related work studies how language models can act through external tools or environments. ReAct introduced a prompting paradigm in which language models interleave reasoning traces with task-directed actions, allowing models to update plans and gather external information during problem solving [ 6 ] . Toolformer showed that language models can be trained to decide when and how to call external APIs, including calculators, retrieval systems, translation systems, and calendars [ 7 ] . These works motivate the comparison between one-shot generation and tool-mediated interaction to determine whether tool-usage improves performance in tasks related to mobility data engineering.
paragraphs.zh: 第一类相关研究探讨了语言模型如何通过外部工具或环境来执行操作。 ReAct 提出了一种提示范式，其中语言模型将推理过程与任务导向的行动交替进行，使模型在解决问题时能够更新计划并获取外部信息 [ 6 ] 。 Toolformer 表明，语言模型可以被训练来决定何时以及如何调用外部 API，包括计算器、检索系统、翻译系统和日历 [ 7 ] 。 这些研究促使我们将一次性生成与工具中介的交互进行比较，以确定工具使用是否能在移动数据工程相关的任务中提升性能。

paragraphs.en: Broader agent benchmarks evaluate language models in interactive environments. AgentBench proposed a multi-environment benchmark for assessing language models as agents in open-ended, multi-turn settings [ 11 ] . Such work is important for evaluating planning and decision making, but it typically emphasizes general-purpose agency across heterogeneous environments. In contrast, the present benchmark narrows the scope to reproducible engineering tasks and the validity of submitted artifacts.

paragraphs.en: Within software engineering, empirical studies have assessed LLMs for code review automation and code-semantic understanding [ 4 , 5 ] . Other work has moved from single-model assistance toward structured and agentic workflows. UCD-LLM uses a multi-agent framework to generate use-case-diagram requirements [ 9 ] , while Kim compares artifact validity under varying LLM-agent configurations [ 10 ] . These studies establish direct precedent for evaluating LLM configurations through software-engineering outcomes. The present study extends this perspective to complete data-engineering artifacts, a local serving constraint, heterogeneous task families, repeated execution, and failure analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 在软件工程领域，实证研究已评估了大型语言模型（LLM）在代码审查自动化和代码语义理解方面的表现 [4, 5]。 其他研究则从单一模型辅助转向了结构化且具备智能体能力的流程。 UCD-LLM 采用多智能体框架来生成用例图需求 [9]，而 Kim 则比较了不同 LLM-智能体配置下产出的有效性 [10]。 这些研究为通过软件工程成果评估 LLM 配置提供了直接的前例。 本研究将这一视角扩展至完整的数据工程产物、本地部署限制、异构任务族、重复执行以及故障分析。

paragraphs.en: A separate body of work has established executable checking as the central evaluation principle for code generation. The Codex paper introduced HumanEval, a benchmark of Python programming problems evaluated by functional correctness rather than surface similarity [ 12 ] . MBPP extended evaluation to short natural-language programming tasks intended to be solvable by entry-level programmers [ 13 ] . CodeXGLUE broadened evaluation across code understanding and generation tasks, providing a multi-task benchmark for program-related machine learning [ 14 ] . More recent benchmarks move closer to realistic engineering work: DS-1000 evaluates data-science code generation using problems derived from practical Python library usage [ 15 ] , and SWE-bench evaluates whether language models can resolve real GitHub issues by editing existing repositories and passing associated tests [ 16 ] . These benchmarks are especially relevant because they use executable or repository-level evaluation. However, they primarily target programming solutions or repository patches. The present benchmark instead evaluates a heterogeneous set of connected engineering outputs, including executable transformations, cleaned tables, validation reports, semantic-linking files, analytical matrices, figures, and reproducible reports. This broadens artifact-level evaluation from source code alone to the products of a complete data-engineering workflow.
paragraphs.zh: 一项独立的研究成果已将可执行验证确立为代码生成评估的核心原则。 Codex 论文引入了 HumanEval，这是一个 Python 编程问题基准测试，其评估依据是功能正确性而非表面相似性 [ 12 ] 。 MBPP 将评估范围扩展到了简短的自然语言编程任务上，这些任务旨在让初级程序员能够解决 [ 13 ] 。 CodeXGLUE 在代码理解与生成任务之间拓展了评估范围，为程序相关的机器学习提供了一个多任务基准测试 [ 14 ] 。 更近期的基准测试则更贴近真实的工程实践：DS-1000 使用源自实际 Python 库使用场景的问题来评估数据科学代码的生成能力 [ 15 ] ，而 SWE-bench 则评估语言模型能否通过编辑现有仓库并通过相关测试来解决真实的 GitHub 问题 [ 16 ] 。 这些基准测试尤其具有现实意义，因为它们采用了可执行或仓库级别的评估方法。 然而，它们主要关注编程解决方案或仓库的补丁修改。 与此不同，本基准测试评估一组异构且相互关联的工程成果，包括可执行的转换、清理后的表格、验证报告、语义链接文件、分析矩阵、图表以及可复现的报告。 这将成果层面的评估从单一源代码扩展到了完整数据工程工作流程所产生的所有产物。

paragraphs.en: Another line of research focuses directly on tool-using models. API-Bank introduced a benchmark and runnable evaluation system for tool-augmented language models, covering API planning, retrieval, and invocation [ 17 ] . StableToolBench addressed the instability of live online APIs by introducing a virtual API server and a more stable evaluation process for large-scale tool-learning benchmarks [ 18 ] . Function-calling benchmarks further refine how tool calls are checked. The Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard evaluates serial, parallel, and multi-step function calling using structured checking, including abstract-syntax-tree-based evaluation [ 19 ] . τ \tau -bench evaluates tool-agent-user interaction in simulated real-world domains and introduces pass k as a measure of behavioral reliability across repeated trials [ 20 ] . ToolSandbox evaluates stateful conversational tool use with intermediate and final milestones, emphasizing state dependencies, canonicalization, and insufficient-information cases [ 21 ] . In this context, we equip LLMs with a minimal tool suite to execute data-engineering workflows and compare the complete closed-loop workspace condition with a one-shot baseline.

paragraphs.en: The present work is also related to research on efficient local language-model inference. In this sense, low-bit post-training quantization methods such as GPTQ [ 22 ] and AWQ [ 23 ] reduce memory and inference costs, making larger models more practical on local hardware. This paper does not propose a new quantization or inference method; instead, it treats local serving, model size, architecture, and precision as configuration choices in an empirical evaluation of artifact-producing engineering assistants.
paragraphs.zh: 当前这项工作也与高效本地语言模型推理的研究相关。 从这个意义上说，低比特后训练量化方法（如 GPTQ [ 22 ] 和 AWQ [ 23 ]）能够降低内存和推理成本，使更大的模型在本地硬件上更具实用性。 本文并未提出新的量化或推理方法；相反，它将本地服务、模型规模、架构和精度视为生成成果的工程助理在经验性评估中的配置选项。

paragraphs.en: Reproducibility is also central to empirical artificial intelligence and software engineering. Many Artificial Intelligence (AI) papers did not document enough information about experiments, data, and methods to support reproducibility [ 24 ] . Reproducibility practices introduced around the NeurIPS reproducibility program, including checklists, code submission, and reproducibility challenges, were systematized shortly thereafter [ 25 ] . DataPerf extended benchmark thinking toward data-centric AI, emphasizing that datasets and data-development processes themselves require systematic evaluation [ 26 ] . The benchmark in this paper adopts these concerns operationally: inputs are fixed, tasks are versioned, outputs are checked deterministically, and logs are machine-readable.

paragraphs.en: Finally, the domain layer of this benchmark builds on public mobility and open-data infrastructures, which provide both standardized data formats and realistic sources for data-oriented tasks. On the mobility side, GTFS defines a widely used tabular standard for public-transport schedules, including files such as stops.txt , trips.txt , and stop_times.txt . Its specification also defines service-day time semantics, under which valid stop times may exceed 24:00:00 [ 27 ] . Together with the MobilityData GTFS validator, which offers a reference point for transit-feed quality rules and validation terminology [ 28 ] , GTFS provides a suitable basis for benchmark tasks involving parsing, validation, cleaning, and service-intensity computation.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，该基准测试的领域层建立在公共出行和开放数据基础设施之上，这些基础设施既提供了标准化的数据格式，也为数据导向的任务提供了真实的数据来源。 在出行方面，GTFS 定义了一种广泛用于公共交通时刻表的表格标准，包括 stops.txt、trips.txt 和 stop_times.txt 等文件。 其规范还定义了服务日的时间语义，在此语义下，有效的停靠时间可能超过 24:00:00 [ 27 ]。 与 MobilityData GTFS 验证器（该验证器为公共交通数据流的质量规则和验证术语提供了参考依据 [ 28 ]）相结合，GTFS 为涉及解析、验证、清理和服务强度计算的基准测试任务提供了合适的基础。

paragraphs.en: Taken together, the related work surveyed above paints a clear trajectory: language-model agents are becoming increasingly capable at tool use, code generation, and interactive problem solving, while local deployment and reproducible evaluation methods are maturing in parallel. These advances open a broad space of domain-specific applications that remain largely unexplored. This paper enters that space by asking how complete local agent configurations perform when they must produce validated engineering artifacts rather than plausible responses. Mobility supplies heterogeneous data sources and domain conventions, but the empirical concern is broader: how workspace feedback, model capability, resource constraints, and task verifiability affect LLM-assisted engineering. To the best of our knowledge, no prior work combines artifact-level mobility data-engineering tasks with a controlled local-model sweep that measures workspace-condition gain, runtime, tool interaction, quantization sensitivity, and failure categories.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，上述综述的相关研究描绘出一条清晰的演进轨迹：语言模型智能体在工具使用、代码生成和交互式问题解决方面的能力日益增强，而本地部署与可复现的评估方法也在同步走向成熟。 这些进步开启了一个广阔的领域特定应用空间，而该空间目前仍基本未被探索。 本文通过研究一个核心问题切入这一领域：当完整的本地智能体配置必须生成经过验证的工程成果，而非仅给出看似合理的回应时，其表现如何。 移动性提供了异构的数据源和领域惯例，但更广泛的实证关注点在于：工作区反馈、模型能力、资源限制和任务可验证性等因素如何影响大型语言模型辅助的工程实践。 据我们所知，尚无先前的研究将成果层面的移动性数据工程任务，与受控的本地模型系统性测试相结合，以衡量工作区条件带来的增益、运行时间、工具交互、量化敏感性和故障类型等指标。

paragraphs.en: The benchmark operationalizes an LLM-based data-engineering assistant as a system that transforms a natural-language task specification and bounded workspace into verifiable output artifacts. Each task provides an instruction, relevant input fixtures, and a specification of the files to be produced. Success is determined from the artifacts rather than from the model’s explanation: deterministic checkers parse, execute, compare, or inspect outputs and verify schemas, numerical constraints, domain rules, and report requirements.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试将基于大型语言模型的数据工程助手具体化为一个系统，该系统能将自然语言的任务说明和受限的工作空间转化为可验证的输出成果。 每个任务都包含一项指令、相关的输入数据以及需要生成的文件规范。 成功与否由输出成果决定，而非模型的解释：确定性检查器会解析、执行、比较或检验输出结果，并验证模式、数值约束、领域规则及报告要求。

paragraphs.en: This design reflects software-engineering practice for data-intensive systems. A useful assistant must do more than describe a plausible workflow: it must select valid records, understand the actual data layout, write executable transformations or structured outputs, handle domain conventions, and leave artifacts that can be tested and audited. The tasks follow an urban analytics workflow from data discovery and feed processing through enrichment, feature construction, validation, and reporting. Decomposing that workflow into independently checked tasks permits capability-level diagnosis while preserving the relationship between upstream transformations and downstream analytical artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: 这种设计体现了面向数据密集型系统的软件工程实践。 一个有用的智能体必须做的不仅仅是描述一个合理的流程：它必须能够选择有效记录、理解实际的数据布局、编写可执行的转换或结构化输出、处理领域内的约定，并留下可供测试和审计的成果。 这些任务遵循了城市分析的工作流程，从数据发现与数据流处理开始，经过数据增强、特征构建、验证和报告生成。 将该工作流程分解为可独立检查的任务，可以在保持上游转换与下游分析成果之间关系的同时，实现能力层面的诊断。

paragraphs.en: The data used by the benchmark is drawn from public mobility and urban-data sources. The Eurostat-style component provides city-level indicator metadata and values for mobility, population, environment, and living-condition variables [ 29 ] . The catalog component provides data.europa.eu-style records, including relevant mobility datasets and non-mobility decoys that test whether a model can distinguish source records from distractors [ 30 ] . The transport component contains a sampled GTFS feed from a public mobility catalog, which supports tasks involving stops, trips, stop times, service-day semantics, and feed validation [ 32 ] . The semantic component contains Wikidata-style point-of-interest records for cultural-accessibility enrichment and geospatial linking [ 31 ] .

paragraphs.en: For reproducibility, these sources are not queried live during evaluation. Instead, all benchmark inputs are committed as local fixture snapshots and every model receives the same files, prompts, workspace structure, and scoring logic. This avoids external variability from API outages, schema changes, or updated source records, making it possible to attribute differences in performance to the model and interaction mode rather than to changes in the data environment.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保可重复性，这些数据源在评估期间不会进行实时查询。 相反，所有基准测试的输入都会被作为本地固定快照保存，每个模型都会收到相同的文件、提示词、工作区结构和评分逻辑。 这样可以避免因 API 中断、模式变更或数据源记录更新所带来的外部变量影响，从而能够将由性能差异归因于模型和交互模式，而非数据环境的变化。

paragraphs.en: Family A: Dataset discovery and connector setup (T01–T03). These tasks test whether a model can identify relevant urban indicators, build a data loader, and reason about catalog records to extract mobility entries while excluding decoys, i.e., catalog records that look structurally valid but describe non-mobility datasets and should therefore be filtered out.
paragraphs.zh: 家族 A：数据集发现与连接器配置（T01–T03）。 这些任务旨在检验模型是否能够识别相关的城市指标、构建数据加载器，并基于目录记录进行推理，从而提取出行相关条目，同时排除干扰项——即那些在结构上看似有效，但实际描述的是非出行类数据集、因此应当被过滤掉的目录记录。

sents.en: Family A: Dataset discovery and connector setup (T01–T03).
sents.zh: 家族 A：数据集发现与连接器配置（T01–T03）。

sents.en: These tasks test whether a model can identify relevant urban indicators, build a data loader, and reason about catalog records to extract mobility entries while excluding decoys, i.e., catalog records that look structurally valid but describe non-mobility datasets and should therefore be filtered out.
sents.zh: 这些任务旨在检验模型是否能够识别相关的城市指标、构建数据加载器，并基于目录记录进行推理，从而提取出行相关条目，同时排除干扰项——即那些在结构上看似有效，但实际描述的是非出行类数据集、因此应当被过滤掉的目录记录。

paragraphs.en: Indicator selection. Requirement: Select Eurostat urban indicators relevant to mobility and livability and produce a CSV that lists each selected indicator with its theme, a brief justification, and the expected analytical direction. Correctness: The output must contain the required columns (theme, justification, direction) and every selected indicator must belong to an approved mobility-related theme.
paragraphs.zh: 指标选择。 要求：选择与出行便利性和宜居性相关的 Eurostat 城市指标，并生成一个 CSV 文件，其中列出每个选定的指标及其主题、简要说明以及预期的分析方向。 正确性：输出必须包含所需的列（主题、说明、方向），且每个选定的指标都必须属于经批准的与出行相关的主题。

sents.en: Indicator selection.
sents.zh: 指标选择。

sents.en: Requirement: Select Eurostat urban indicators relevant to mobility and livability and produce a CSV that lists each selected indicator with its theme, a brief justification, and the expected analytical direction.
sents.zh: 要求：选择与出行便利性和宜居性相关的 Eurostat 城市指标，并生成一个 CSV 文件，其中列出每个选定的指标及其主题、简要说明以及预期的分析方向。

sents.en: Correctness: The output must contain the required columns (theme, justification, direction) and every selected indicator must belong to an approved mobility-related theme.
sents.zh: 正确性：输出必须包含所需的列（主题、说明、方向），且每个选定的指标都必须属于经批准的与出行相关的主题。

paragraphs.en: Loader construction. Requirement: Build an executable Python loader for the selected Eurostat-style indicator values and produce a normalized long-format CSV. Correctness: The script must run without errors and the output CSV must contain the expected indicator, city, year, and value columns with properly melted structure.
paragraphs.zh: 加载器构建。 要求：为选定的 Eurostat 风格指标值构建一个可执行的 Python 加载器，并生成一个经过归一化的长格式 CSV 文件。 正确性：脚本必须无错误运行，且输出的 CSV 文件必须包含预期的指标、城市、年份和数值列，并具有正确的融化结构。

sents.en: Loader construction.
sents.zh: 加载器构建。

sents.en: Requirement: Build an executable Python loader for the selected Eurostat-style indicator values and produce a normalized long-format CSV.
sents.zh: 要求：为选定的 Eurostat 风格指标值构建一个可执行的 Python 加载器，并生成一个经过归一化的长格式 CSV 文件。

sents.en: Correctness: The script must run without errors and the output CSV must contain the expected indicator, city, year, and value columns with properly melted structure.
sents.zh: 正确性：脚本必须无错误运行，且输出的 CSV 文件必须包含预期的指标、城市、年份和数值列，并具有正确的融化结构。

paragraphs.en: Catalog filtering. Requirement: Extract mobility-related records from catalog metadata and produce a mobility catalog CSV that excludes non-mobility decoy records. Correctness: The output must contain all mobility entries and no decoys.
paragraphs.zh: 目录筛选。 要求：从目录元数据中提取与移动性相关的记录，并生成一个不包含非移动性虚假记录的移动性目录 CSV 文件。 正确性：输出必须包含所有移动性条目，且不含任何虚假记录。

sents.en: Catalog filtering.
sents.zh: 目录筛选。

sents.en: Requirement: Extract mobility-related records from catalog metadata and produce a mobility catalog CSV that excludes non-mobility decoy records.
sents.zh: 要求：从目录元数据中提取与移动性相关的记录，并生成一个不包含非移动性虚假记录的移动性目录 CSV 文件。

sents.en: Correctness: The output must contain all mobility entries and no decoys.
sents.zh: 正确性：输出必须包含所有移动性条目，且不含任何虚假记录。

paragraphs.en: Family B: GTFS processing (T04–T06). These tasks test parsing, validation, data cleaning, and transit-service aggregation, including the domain-specific distinction between invalid clock times and valid extended GTFS service-day times.
paragraphs.zh: 家庭 B：GTFS 处理（T04–T06）。 这些任务用于测试解析、验证、数据清理和交通服务聚合，包括在无效时钟时间与有效的扩展 GTFS 服务日时间之间进行领域特定的区分。

sents.en: Family B: GTFS processing (T04–T06).
sents.zh: 家庭 B：GTFS 处理（T04–T06）。

sents.en: These tasks test parsing, validation, data cleaning, and transit-service aggregation, including the domain-specific distinction between invalid clock times and valid extended GTFS service-day times.
sents.zh: 这些任务用于测试解析、验证、数据清理和交通服务聚合，包括在无效时钟时间与有效的扩展 GTFS 服务日时间之间进行领域特定的区分。

paragraphs.en: Feed validation. Requirement: Validate and parse a GTFS feed and produce a JSON summary of mandatory files, required columns, and row counts. Correctness: The JSON must list every mandatory file, every required column per file, and accurate row counts.
paragraphs.zh: 数据源验证。 要求：验证并解析一个 GTFS 数据源，生成一个包含必需文件、必要列和行数统计信息的 JSON 摘要。 正确性：该 JSON 必须列出所有必需文件、每个文件的必要列以及准确的行数。

sents.en: Feed validation.
sents.zh: 数据源验证。

sents.en: Requirement: Validate and parse a GTFS feed and produce a JSON summary of mandatory files, required columns, and row counts.
sents.zh: 要求：验证并解析一个 GTFS 数据源，生成一个包含必需文件、必要列和行数统计信息的 JSON 摘要。

sents.en: Correctness: The JSON must list every mandatory file, every required column per file, and accurate row counts.
sents.zh: 正确性：该 JSON 必须列出所有必需文件、每个文件的必要列以及准确的行数。

paragraphs.en: Data cleaning. Requirement: Clean GTFS coordinates, duplicate stops, missing names, and service-day times, producing a cleaning report together with cleaned stops and stop-times tables. Correctness: The cleaned tables must remove duplicates and blanks, correct invalid coordinates, and preserve the valid extended service-day time ( 25:10:00 ).
paragraphs.zh: 数据清洗。 要求：清洗 GTFS 坐标、重复站点、缺失名称和服务日时间，并生成一份清洗报告，同时提供已清洗的站点和站点时间表。 正确性：清洗后的表格必须移除重复项和空值，修正无效的坐标，并保留有效的扩展服务日时间（25:10:00）。

sents.en: Data cleaning.
sents.zh: 数据清洗。

sents.en: Requirement: Clean GTFS coordinates, duplicate stops, missing names, and service-day times, producing a cleaning report together with cleaned stops and stop-times tables.
sents.zh: 要求：清洗 GTFS 坐标、重复站点、缺失名称和服务日时间，并生成一份清洗报告，同时提供已清洗的站点和站点时间表。

sents.en: Correctness: The cleaned tables must remove duplicates and blanks, correct invalid coordinates, and preserve the valid extended service-day time ( 25:10:00 ).
sents.zh: 正确性：清洗后的表格必须移除重复项和空值，修正无效的坐标，并保留有效的扩展服务日时间（25:10:00）。

paragraphs.en: Service intensity. Requirement: Compute stop-level service intensity and produce a stop table with departure counts, route counts, and first/last departure times. Correctness: Aggregated values must match the ground-truth schedule and times must respect GTFS service-day semantics.
paragraphs.zh: 服务强度。 要求：计算停靠级别的服务强度，并生成一个停靠表，其中包含发车次数、路线数量以及首次/末次发车时间。 正确性：汇总值必须与基准时刻表一致，且时间必须符合 GTFS 服务日语义。

sents.en: Service intensity.
sents.zh: 服务强度。

sents.en: Requirement: Compute stop-level service intensity and produce a stop table with departure counts, route counts, and first/last departure times.
sents.zh: 要求：计算停靠级别的服务强度，并生成一个停靠表，其中包含发车次数、路线数量以及首次/末次发车时间。

sents.en: Correctness: Aggregated values must match the ground-truth schedule and times must respect GTFS service-day semantics.
sents.zh: 正确性：汇总值必须与基准时刻表一致，且时间必须符合 GTFS 服务日语义。

paragraphs.en: Family C: Semantic enrichment (T07–T09). These tasks test whether a model can express a plausible Wikidata SPARQL query, clean geospatial POI records, and perform a nearest-stop join using distances in meters.
paragraphs.zh: 家族 C：语义增强（T07–T09）。 这些任务旨在检验模型是否能够生成合理的 Wikidata SPARQL 查询、清理地理空间兴趣点记录，以及基于米制距离执行最近站点连接操作。

sents.en: Family C: Semantic enrichment (T07–T09).
sents.zh: 家族 C：语义增强（T07–T09）。

sents.en: These tasks test whether a model can express a plausible Wikidata SPARQL query, clean geospatial POI records, and perform a nearest-stop join using distances in meters.
sents.zh: 这些任务旨在检验模型是否能够生成合理的 Wikidata SPARQL 查询、清理地理空间兴趣点记录，以及基于米制距离执行最近站点连接操作。

paragraphs.en: SPARQL query generation. Requirement: Generate a Wikidata SPARQL query for cultural points of interest. Correctness: The query must request entities, labels, coordinates, and location constraints with syntactically valid SPARQL structure.
paragraphs.zh: SPARQL 查询生成。 要求：生成一个用于文化兴趣点的 Wikidata SPARQL 查询。 正确性：该查询必须通过语法正确的 SPARQL 结构请求实体、标签、坐标和位置约束。

sents.en: SPARQL query generation.
sents.zh: SPARQL 查询生成。

sents.en: Requirement: Generate a Wikidata SPARQL query for cultural points of interest.
sents.zh: 要求：生成一个用于文化兴趣点的 Wikidata SPARQL 查询。

sents.en: Correctness: The query must request entities, labels, coordinates, and location constraints with syntactically valid SPARQL structure.
sents.zh: 正确性：该查询必须通过语法正确的 SPARQL 结构请求实体、标签、坐标和位置约束。

paragraphs.en: POI cleaning. Requirement: Clean Wikidata-style POI records and produce a table with unique entities, labels, types, coordinates, and source. Correctness: Duplicate entity identifiers must be deduplicated, blank labels must be handled, and the schema must match the specification.
paragraphs.zh: 清理兴趣点。 要求：清理维基数据风格的兴趣点记录，并生成一个包含唯一实体、标签、类型、坐标和来源的表格。 正确性：必须去重重复的实体标识符，处理空标签，并确保模式符合规范。

sents.en: POI cleaning.
sents.zh: 清理兴趣点。

sents.en: Requirement: Clean Wikidata-style POI records and produce a table with unique entities, labels, types, coordinates, and source.
sents.zh: 要求：清理维基数据风格的兴趣点记录，并生成一个包含唯一实体、标签、类型、坐标和来源的表格。

sents.en: Correctness: Duplicate entity identifiers must be deduplicated, blank labels must be handled, and the schema must match the specification.
sents.zh: 正确性：必须去重重复的实体标识符，处理空标签，并确保模式符合规范。

paragraphs.en: Nearest-stop linking. Requirement: Link each POI to its nearest public-transport stop and produce a POI-to-stop table with haversine-style distances in meters. Correctness: Distances must be computed in meters (not coordinate degrees) and each POI must be matched to the correct nearest stop.
paragraphs.zh: 最近站点关联。 要求：将每个兴趣点关联到其最近的公共交通站点，并生成一个包含哈佛辛距离（单位：米）的兴趣点到站点对照表。 正确性：距离必须以米为单位计算（而非坐标度），且每个兴趣点都必须匹配到正确的最近站点。

sents.en: Nearest-stop linking.
sents.zh: 最近站点关联。

sents.en: Requirement: Link each POI to its nearest public-transport stop and produce a POI-to-stop table with haversine-style distances in meters.
sents.zh: 要求：将每个兴趣点关联到其最近的公共交通站点，并生成一个包含哈佛辛距离（单位：米）的兴趣点到站点对照表。

sents.en: Correctness: Distances must be computed in meters (not coordinate degrees) and each POI must be matched to the correct nearest stop.
sents.zh: 正确性：距离必须以米为单位计算（而非坐标度），且每个兴趣点都必须匹配到正确的最近站点。

paragraphs.en: Family D: Feature engineering and analytics (T10–T13). These tasks test formula-following, pivoting, missingness analysis, and a fixed clustering pipeline.
paragraphs.zh: 家族 D：特征工程与分析（T10–T13）。 这些任务测试公式遵循、数据转置、缺失值分析以及固定的聚类流程。

sents.en: Family D: Feature engineering and analytics (T10–T13).
sents.zh: 家族 D：特征工程与分析（T10–T13）。

sents.en: These tasks test formula-following, pivoting, missingness analysis, and a fixed clustering pipeline.
sents.zh: 这些任务测试公式遵循、数据转置、缺失值分析以及固定的聚类流程。

paragraphs.en: Accessibility scoring. Requirement: Compute a cultural accessibility score combining distance, departures, routes, and a normalized score. Correctness: The formula must be implemented exactly as specified and the output table must contain all required columns.
paragraphs.zh: 无障碍性评分。 要求：计算一个结合距离、出发班次、路线和标准化得分的文化无障碍性分数。 正确性：必须严格按照指定公式实现，且输出表必须包含所有必要列。

sents.en: Accessibility scoring.
sents.zh: 无障碍性评分。

sents.en: Requirement: Compute a cultural accessibility score combining distance, departures, routes, and a normalized score.
sents.zh: 要求：计算一个结合距离、出发班次、路线和标准化得分的文化无障碍性分数。

sents.en: Correctness: The formula must be implemented exactly as specified and the output table must contain all required columns.
sents.zh: 正确性：必须严格按照指定公式实现，且输出表必须包含所有必要列。

paragraphs.en: Analytical matrix. Requirement: Create a city-year by indicator matrix from long-format Eurostat values. Correctness: The matrix must have the correct shape, indices, and populated cells.
paragraphs.zh: 分析矩阵。 要求：根据长格式的 Eurostat 数据，创建一个“城市-年份”与指标对应的矩阵。 正确性：该矩阵必须具有正确的形状、索引和已填充的单元格。

sents.en: Analytical matrix.
sents.zh: 分析矩阵。

sents.en: Requirement: Create a city-year by indicator matrix from long-format Eurostat values.
sents.zh: 要求：根据长格式的 Eurostat 数据，创建一个“城市-年份”与指标对应的矩阵。

sents.en: Correctness: The matrix must have the correct shape, indices, and populated cells.
sents.zh: 正确性：该矩阵必须具有正确的形状、索引和已填充的单元格。

paragraphs.en: Missingness filtering. Requirement: Select robust indicators based on missingness and produce a missingness report together with a selected matrix using a 70% coverage rule. Correctness: Only indicators with at least 70% non-missing coverage may be retained.
paragraphs.zh: 缺失值过滤。 要求：根据缺失值情况选择稳健的指标，并依据 70% 覆盖规则生成缺失值报告及选定的矩阵。 正确性：仅允许保留非缺失覆盖率达到至少 70% 的指标。

sents.en: Missingness filtering.
sents.zh: 缺失值过滤。

sents.en: Requirement: Select robust indicators based on missingness and produce a missingness report together with a selected matrix using a 70% coverage rule.
sents.zh: 要求：根据缺失值情况选择稳健的指标，并依据 70% 覆盖规则生成缺失值报告及选定的矩阵。

sents.en: Correctness: Only indicators with at least 70% non-missing coverage may be retained.
sents.zh: 正确性：仅允许保留非缺失覆盖率达到至少 70% 的指标。

paragraphs.en: City clustering. Requirement: Cluster cities into mobility and livability profiles and produce cluster assignments together with cluster-profile summaries. Correctness: Cluster labels must match the ground-truth assignments obtained from the specified algorithm and parameters.
paragraphs.zh: 城市聚类。 要求：将城市按出行便利性和宜居性特征进行聚类，并生成聚类分配结果及聚类特征摘要。 正确性：聚类标签必须与通过指定算法和参数获得的真实分配结果一致。

sents.en: City clustering.
sents.zh: 城市聚类。

sents.en: Requirement: Cluster cities into mobility and livability profiles and produce cluster assignments together with cluster-profile summaries.
sents.zh: 要求：将城市按出行便利性和宜居性特征进行聚类，并生成聚类分配结果及聚类特征摘要。

sents.en: Correctness: Cluster labels must match the ground-truth assignments obtained from the specified algorithm and parameters.
sents.zh: 正确性：聚类标签必须与通过指定算法和参数获得的真实分配结果一致。

paragraphs.en: Family E: Validation, visualization, and reporting (T14–T15). These tasks test whether the model can validate the resulting pipeline artifacts and write a compact report that cites generated outputs without unsupported claims.
paragraphs.zh: 家族 E：验证、可视化和报告（T14–T15）。 这些任务用于检验模型是否能够验证生成的流程产物，并撰写一份简洁的报告，其中引用生成的输出结果时不包含无法证实的主张。

sents.en: Family E: Validation, visualization, and reporting (T14–T15).
sents.zh: 家族 E：验证、可视化和报告（T14–T15）。

sents.en: These tasks test whether the model can validate the resulting pipeline artifacts and write a compact report that cites generated outputs without unsupported claims.
sents.zh: 这些任务用于检验模型是否能够验证生成的流程产物，并撰写一份简洁的报告，其中引用生成的输出结果时不包含无法证实的主张。

paragraphs.en: Output validation. Requirement: Generate an executable validation script for pipeline outputs and produce a validation-summary JSON. Correctness: The script must run without errors and the JSON must accurately reflect which checks passed and which failed.
paragraphs.zh: 输出验证。 要求：生成一个可用于管道输出的可执行验证脚本，并生成一个验证摘要 JSON。 正确性：该脚本必须能够无错误运行，且 JSON 必须准确反映哪些检查通过、哪些失败。

sents.en: Output validation.
sents.zh: 输出验证。

sents.en: Requirement: Generate an executable validation script for pipeline outputs and produce a validation-summary JSON.
sents.zh: 要求：生成一个可用于管道输出的可执行验证脚本，并生成一个验证摘要 JSON。

sents.en: Correctness: The script must run without errors and the JSON must accurately reflect which checks passed and which failed.
sents.zh: 正确性：该脚本必须能够无错误运行，且 JSON 必须准确反映哪些检查通过、哪些失败。

paragraphs.en: Reproducible reporting. Requirement: Produce a reproducible Markdown report together with two non-empty analysis figure files. Correctness: The report must reference generated artifacts and avoid unsupported claims, while the two required figure files must exist and be non-empty.
paragraphs.zh: 可复现的报告。 要求：生成一份可复现的 Markdown 报告，并附带两个非空的分析图表文件。 正确性：报告必须引用生成的产物，避免提出缺乏依据的主张；同时，两个必需的图表文件必须存在且非空。

sents.en: Reproducible reporting.
sents.zh: 可复现的报告。

sents.en: Requirement: Produce a reproducible Markdown report together with two non-empty analysis figure files.
sents.zh: 要求：生成一份可复现的 Markdown 报告，并附带两个非空的分析图表文件。

sents.en: Correctness: The report must reference generated artifacts and avoid unsupported claims, while the two required figure files must exist and be non-empty.
sents.zh: 正确性：报告必须引用生成的产物，避免提出缺乏依据的主张；同时，两个必需的图表文件必须存在且非空。

paragraphs.en: Together, these five families cover the full data-engineering lifecycle from discovery and ingestion through cleaning, enrichment, analytics, validation, and reporting. By decomposing the workflow into independently scored tasks, the benchmark pinpoints exactly which stages are within reach of a given model and which remain difficult.
paragraphs.zh: 这五个阶段共同涵盖了数据工程的全生命周期，从数据发现与摄入，到清洗、增强、分析、验证和报告。 通过将工作流程分解为可独立评分的任务，该基准测试能够精准识别出特定模型能够处理的阶段，以及仍具有挑战性的阶段。

sents.zh: 通过将工作流程分解为可独立评分的任务，该基准测试能够精准识别出特定模型能够处理的阶段，以及仍具有挑战性的阶段。

paragraphs.en: The harness evaluates each task in two modes because one of the main research questions is not only whether a model can solve a task, but whether equipping it with a minimal local workspace loop materially improves its ability to produce correct and reproducible artifacts. In other words, the benchmark asks whether the agentic closed-loop behavior described above, in which a model inspects files, executes code, and repairs its own outputs, translates into measurable engineering value. Comparing a tool-free one-shot condition with a transparent tool-mediated condition allows us to estimate the practical contribution of this deployable agent setup.
paragraphs.zh: 该测试框架以两种模式评估每个任务，因为主要研究问题之一不仅是模型能否解决某个任务，更在于为其配备一个最小的本地工作空间循环，是否确实能提升其生成正确且可复现成果的能力。 换言之，这项基准测试旨在探究上述智能体式闭环行为——即模型检查文件、执行代码并修正自身输出——是否真正能转化为可量化的工程价值。 通过对比无工具的单次尝试条件与透明工具辅助的条件，我们能够估算出这种可部署的智能体架构的实际贡献。

paragraphs.en: We therefore evaluate two modes. In chat-only mode, the model receives the task prompt and output requirements and must provide the required artifacts in a single response. The harness extracts files from the response, writes them into the workspace, and invokes the checker. This mode measures the model’s ability to synthesize complete outputs without local inspection or execution.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，我们评估两种模式。 在仅聊天模式下，模型接收任务提示和输出要求，并必须在单次响应中提供所需的产物。 测试框架从响应中提取文件，将其写入工作区，然后调用检查器。 该模式衡量模型在没有本地检查或执行的情况下合成完整输出的能力。

paragraphs.en: In agent-with-tools mode, the model operates in an isolated local workspace. The tool interface exposes five actions: reading a file, writing a file, editing a string in an existing file, running a shell command, and submitting the final answer. This minimal set of tools allows the model to inspect inputs, create scripts, run local checks, view command output, revise files, and decide when to submit. The hidden checker is invoked only after submission. The interface is deliberately minimal so that the benchmark measures the interaction between model capability and a transparent workspace loop, rather than the behavior of a complex external agent framework.
paragraphs.zh: 在“智能体-工具”模式下，模型在一个隔离的本地工作空间中运行。 该工具接口提供了五个操作：读取文件、写入文件、编辑现有文件中的字符串、执行 shell 命令以及提交最终答案。 这套精简的工具集使模型能够检查输入、创建脚本、执行本地检查、查看命令输出、修改文件，并决定何时提交。 隐藏的检查器仅在提交之后才会被调用。 该接口刻意设计得极为简洁，以便基准测试能衡量模型能力与透明工作空间循环之间的交互，而非复杂外部智能体框架的行为。

sents.zh: 两种模式都接收相同的任务定义，并使用相同的检查器进行评分。

paragraphs.en: Each task has a deterministic checker that returns a binary success value, checker errors, a failure category, and task-specific metadata. The primary evaluation focuses on artifact correctness, because this is the property that matters most in data-engineering automation: generated files must have the required structure, scripts must execute, etc. The checkers therefore evaluate the artifact type appropriate to the task, including schemas, row-level rules, JSON fields, etc. For artifacts containing natural language, the checker evaluates structural compliance, required coverage, and consistency with generated data, but does not attempt to score subjective prose quality. All generated artifacts and logs are retained, so future analyses can apply human review or LLM-judge methods to prose quality if that question is of interest, but the benchmark’s primary score deliberately remains tied to reproducible artifact-level correctness.
paragraphs.zh: 每个任务都有一个确定性检查器，该检查器会返回一个二值成功标志、检查错误、失败类别以及任务特定的元数据。 主要评估聚焦于生成物的正确性，因为这是数据工程自动化中最关键的属性：生成的文件必须具备所需结构，脚本必须能够执行等。 因此，检查器会根据任务类型评估相应的生成物，包括模式、行级规则、JSON 字段等。 对于包含自然语言的生成物，检查器会评估其结构合规性、必要覆盖范围以及与生成数据的一致性，但不会尝试对主观的文本质量进行评分。 所有生成的生成物和日志都会被保留，因此未来的分析可以应用人工审查或 LLM 判读方法来评估文本质量（如果该问题具有研究价值），但该基准测试的主要评分仍刻意与可复现的生成物级正确性挂钩。

paragraphs.en: We group unsuccessful attempts into the following categories:
paragraphs.zh: 我们将未成功的尝试归入以下类别：

paragraphs.en: Logic errors: Structurally valid outputs that violate task rules, such as using the wrong filter, computing the wrong aggregate, or returning an incorrect row count.
paragraphs.zh: 逻辑错误：结构上有效的输出，但违反了任务规则，例如使用了错误的过滤器、计算了错误的聚合值，或返回了不正确的行数。

paragraphs.en: Protocol errors: Invalid or missing tool calls, including malformed responses; an attempt is stopped after eight consecutive protocol errors.
paragraphs.zh: 协议错误：无效或缺失的工具调用，包括格式错误的响应；连续出现八次协议错误后，尝试将停止。

paragraphs.en: Format errors: Files that exist but cannot be parsed, such as malformed CSV or invalid JSON.
paragraphs.zh: 格式错误：文件存在但无法解析，例如格式错误的 CSV 或无效的 JSON。

paragraphs.en: Schema errors: Missing files, missing columns, or unusable artifact structure, for example omitting a required result CSV or report section.
paragraphs.zh: 模式错误：文件缺失、列缺失或工件结构不可用，例如遗漏了必需的结果 CSV 或报告部分。

paragraphs.en: Wrong data source: Outputs that use identifiers or records not present in the provided fixture, such as selecting a decoy file from the catalog.
paragraphs.zh: 错误的数据源：使用未出现在所提供测试用例中的标识符或记录的输出，例如从目录中选择诱饵文件。

paragraphs.en: Tool-error loops: Repeated failed tool calls or repeated commands that do not make progress; the harness stops an attempt after eight repeated failures of the same tool call.
paragraphs.zh: 工具错误循环：重复失败的工具调用或无法取得进展的重复命令；当同一工具调用连续失败八次后，执行框架将停止当前尝试。

paragraphs.en: Tool loops: Repeated valid tool calls that do not make progress; the harness stops an attempt after twenty repetitions of the same tool call.
paragraphs.zh: 工具循环：重复执行有效工具调用但未能取得进展；在相同工具调用重复二十次后，执行框架将停止当前尝试。

paragraphs.en: Domain errors: Violations of mobility-specific conventions, such as incorrect GTFS time handling, geospatial matching, or query constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 领域错误：违反移动性特定约定的错误，例如不正确处理 GTFS 时间、地理空间匹配或查询约束。

paragraphs.en: These categories allow the analysis to distinguish a model that cannot produce the required file shape from a model that produces valid files but applies the wrong domain logic.
paragraphs.zh: 这些类别使得分析能够区分无法生成所需文件结构的模型，与能生成有效文件但应用了错误领域逻辑的模型。

paragraphs.en: Every reported metric is extracted automatically from the execution trace rather than assigned through subjective human judgment. The run logger records model identifier, task identifier, interaction mode, repetition, final checker result, failure category, runtime, and tool-call counts. This structured logging makes the evaluation fully reproducible and enables direct comparison across models, tasks, and families.
paragraphs.zh: 所有报告的指标均从执行轨迹中自动提取，而非通过主观的人类判断来指定。 运行记录器会记录模型标识符、任务标识符、交互模式、重复次数、最终检查器结果、失败类别、运行时间以及工具调用次数。 这种结构化日志使评估完全可重现，并支持在不同模型、任务和系列之间进行直接比较。

paragraphs.en: The experiments evaluate Qwen-family local models [ 33 ] served through a local llama.cpp [ 34 ] endpoint on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU. The evaluated suite spans the Qwen 3.5 and 3.6 families, with model sizes from 2B to 35B parameters in both dense and mixture-of-experts (MoE) architectures [ 35 ] (Table 2 ). The 35B-A3B configurations are MoE models with 35B total parameters and approximately 3B active parameters during each forward pass. Because the 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE models do not fit into the 24 GB of VRAM available on the RTX 4090 in BF16, we decided to use the models quantized with Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 GGUF at UD-Q4_K_XL [ 36 ] . This is a higher-fidelity 4-bit quantization that uses larger intermediate tensors and dynamic scaling to preserve more accuracy in critical weight groups, while still remaining within the memory budget of consumer GPUs. Using the same quantization across evaluated sizes reduces precision level as a source of variation in the scale comparison. However, to test whether this aggressive quantization harms smaller models that have less representational headroom, additional unquantized BF16 variants of the 2B, 4B, and 9B models were also evaluated because they fit on a consumer-grade GPU.
paragraphs.zh: 实验评估了通过本地 llama.cpp [34] 端点在单块 NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 GPU 上运行的 Qwen 系列本地模型 [33]。 评估的模型套件涵盖 Qwen 3.5 和 3.6 系列，模型规模从 2B 到 35B 参数不等，同时支持密集架构和专家混合（MoE）架构 [35]（表 2）。 35B-A3B 配置是 MoE 模型，总参数为 35B，每次前向传播中约有 3B 参数处于激活状态。 由于 27B 密集模型和 35B-A3B MoE 模型无法在 RTX 4090 的 24 GB BF16 VRAM 内存中完整运行，我们决定使用通过 Unsloth Dynamic 2.0 GGUF 以 UD-Q4_K_XL [36] 格式量化的模型。 这是一种更高保真度的 4 位量化方法，它使用更大的中间张量和动态缩放来在关键权重组中保留更多精度，同时仍控制在消费级 GPU 的内存预算范围内。 在所有评估的模型规模中统一使用相同的量化方式，可消除精度水平作为规模比较中变异来源的影响。 然而，为了测试这种激进量化是否会对表示能力较弱的较小模型造成损害，我们还额外评估了未量化的 2B、4B 和 9B 模型的 BF16 版本，因为这些模型能够运行在消费级 GPU 上。

paragraphs.en: The model set is deliberately a controlled within-family sweep rather than a broad leaderboard across unrelated open-weight families. This choice prioritizes the questions that are most central to local deployment in this paper: how capability changes with scale, whether a sparse MoE model changes the latency–accuracy trade-off, whether a newer generation improves the frontier, and whether aggressive quantization changes success near the capability threshold. Adding many model families would introduce additional confounds, including tokenizer differences, chat templates, training data, instruction tuning, tool-call behavior, and quantization availability. This focused scope supports a more controlled analysis of scale and efficiency trade-offs, while the released benchmark can be extended to other model families in future replications.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型集是有意设计为受控的家族内横向对比，而非跨多个无关开放权重模型的广泛排行榜。 这一选择优先关注本文本地部署中最核心的问题：能力如何随规模变化、稀疏 MoE 模型是否会改变延迟与准确率的权衡关系、新一代模型是否提升了性能前沿，以及激进量化是否在接近能力阈值时影响成功与否。 加入更多模型家族会引入额外的干扰因素，包括分词器差异、聊天模板、训练数据、指令微调、工具调用行为以及量化支持情况。 这种聚焦的范畴有助于更受控地分析规模与效率之间的权衡关系，同时已发布的基准测试也可在未来的复现研究中扩展至其他模型家族。

sents.en: Adding many model families would introduce additional confounds, including tokenizer differences, chat templates, training data, instruction tuning, tool-call behavior, and quantization availability.
sents.zh: 加入更多模型家族会引入额外的干扰因素，包括分词器差异、聊天模板、训练数据、指令微调、工具调用行为以及量化支持情况。

sents.en: This focused scope supports a more controlled analysis of scale and efficiency trade-offs, while the released benchmark can be extended to other model families in future replications.

paragraphs.en: All reported results use the Unsloth-recommended generation configuration for Qwen 3.5 non-thinking precise-coding mode: temperature=0.6 , top_p=0.95 , top_k=20 , min_p=0.0 , presence_penalty=0.0 , and repeat_penalty=1.0 . The choice was also motivated by preliminary observations with greedy decoding ( temperature=0.0 ), where repetitions were nearly identical and some models entered repetitive tool loops that did not converge. These preliminary runs were used to select a stable common configuration and are not included in the 1,500 scored attempts. The study therefore evaluates the reported models under one fixed stochastic generation policy; it does not attempt to estimate the independent effect of decoding parameters.

paragraphs.en: Building on the offline-fixture design described above, all benchmark runs use the same committed snapshot so that every model is evaluated under identical input conditions. For the evaluation reported here, this snapshot contains 5,373 Eurostat value rows, 160 Eurostat indicator descriptions, 26 catalog records including one selected GTFS feed record, a GTFS subset with 81 stops after controls, 80 trips, 180 stop-time rows, and 51 Wikidata POI rows after controls. This fixed snapshot operationalizes the reproducibility requirement: the benchmark does not depend on live APIs that might fail, return inconsistent results, or change schema between runs. As a result, input data are not a source of variation when comparing model performance. The raw source downloads are retained outside the public benchmark input tree, while the benchmark inputs and provenance record are versioned with the harness.
paragraphs.zh: 基于上述描述的离线固定设计，所有基准测试运行都使用相同的已提交快照，从而确保每个模型都在完全一致输入条件下进行评估。 在本报告所评估的测试中，该快照包含 5,373 行 Eurostat 值数据、160 条 Eurostat 指标描述、26 条目录记录（其中包括一条选定的 GTFS 源数据记录）、经过筛选后包含 81 个站点的 GTFS 子集、80 趟行程、180 行站点时间数据，以及经过筛选后 51 条 Wikidata 兴趣点数据。 这一固定快照将可重复性要求具体化：基准测试不依赖可能发生故障、返回不一致结果或在不同运行间改变结构的实时 API。 因此，在比较模型性能时，输入数据不会成为变异的来源。 原始源数据的下载文件保留在公共基准测试输入树之外，而基准测试输入和来源记录则与测试框架一同进行版本管理。

paragraphs.en: The harness creates an isolated attempt workspace containing the fixed input snapshot and empty output, source, report, and figure directories.

paragraphs.en: The model receives the task prompt together with a system prompt specifying five JSON-schema tools: read , write , edit , bash , and submit .

paragraphs.en: Each attempt is also bounded by fixed execution caps to prevent non-converging runs from consuming unbounded time while preserving the failure signal. We allow at most 1000 interaction iterations, 1000 total tool calls, one hour of wall-clock time per task, and 60 seconds for each shell command. To stop traces that are clearly no longer making progress, the harness also terminates after eight consecutive malformed tool-call responses, eight repeated failed tool calls, or 20 repeated identical tool calls. When a cap is reached, the stop reason and cap flags are recorded in the trace and the attempt is evaluated as a failed model run unless the trace indicates an infrastructure problem. The caps allowed agents to recover from local errors and pursue alternative solutions while terminating traces that failed to make progress within the one-hour task budget.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we present the results obtained during the benchmark process. We evaluate the ten local Qwen configurations listed in Table 2 on the fifteen defined tasks in both chat_only and agent_tools modes. The model set spans 2B, 4B, 9B, 27B, and 35B-A3B parameter regimes. All size classes are evaluated with UD-Q4_K_XL quantization, while the 2B, 4B, and 9B Qwen 3.5 models are also evaluated in BF16 because they fit on the available RTX 4090 consumer-grade GPU. Only the 27B dense and 35B-A3B MoE configurations are evaluated for both Qwen 3.5 and Qwen 3.6, as the smaller variants have not been published in the 3.6 version. Each model/mode/task condition is repeated five times, yielding 10 × 2 × 15 × 5 = 1500 10\times 2\times 15\times 5=1500 scored attempts. We report Wilson 95% intervals as descriptive summaries of pooled attempt-level pass rates. Because attempts are organized within fixed task strata and only five repetitions are available per model/task cell, these intervals should not be interpreted as population-level uncertainty over all possible data-engineering tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们展示基准测试过程中获得的结果。 我们在 chat_only 和 agent_tools 两种模式下，对表 2 中列出的十种本地 Qwen 配置在十五项既定任务上进行了评估。 该模型集合涵盖了 2B、4B、9B、27B 和 35B-A3B 参数规模。 所有规模类别均使用 UD-Q4_K_XL 量化进行评估，而 2B、4B 和 9B 的 Qwen 3.5 模型也使用 BF16 进行评估，因为它们能够适配可用的 RTX 4090 消费级 GPU。 仅对 27B 密集模型和 35B-A3B MoE 配置在 Qwen 3.5 和 Qwen 3.6 两个版本中进行了评估，因为较小规模的变体尚未在 3.6 版本中发布。 每个模型/模式/任务条件均重复五次，共产生 10 × 2 × 15 × 5 = 1500 次评分尝试。 我们以威尔逊 95% 置信区间作为合并后的尝试级通过率描述性摘要。 由于每次尝试都组织在固定的任务分层中，且每个模型/任务单元格仅可用五次重复测试，因此不应将这些区间解释为所有可能数据工程任务上的总体不确定性。

paragraphs.en: Quantized agent-mode analysis: we analyze the natural operating setting for the benchmark, where all models use the same local workspace interface and the same UD-Q4_K_XL quantization level.

paragraphs.en: The best results come from the Qwen 3.6 family, led by the 27B dense at 85.3% and followed by the 35B-A3B MoE at 81.3%. paragraphs.en: We next analyze the observed “agentic gain”: the increase in pass rate when models can inspect files, use tools, observe execution feedback, and self-verify artifacts instead of receiving one opportunity to submit the result. paragraphs.en: Finally, the heatmaps also make visible an important reliability issue: each model/task cell is based on five repetitions with the same prompt, inputs, checker, and execution environment. Therefore, an 80% pass rate means that the model solved four out of five nominally identical attempts, while a 40% pass rate means that the same model and task alternated between success and failure across repetitions. These intermediate rates show that agents are stochastic systems whose generated plans, tool calls, and repair trajectories can diverge even when the benchmark conditions are fixed. For engineering assessment, a single successful run is therefore weaker evidence than repeated success; repeated trials and task-specific validation are important when the cost of failure is high.

paragraphs.en: Verifiability and agentic gain. The task-level results also show that agentic gain depends strongly on whether the model can verify its own intermediate work. T08 is the clearest positive example. The task requires converting a Wikidata-style JSON snapshot into a normalized point-of-interest CSV, including coordinate parsing, identifier deduplication, fallback labels, and a fixed output schema. No model passes T08 in chat_only mode (0/50 attempts), whereas agent mode passes 37/50 attempts. Even Qwen 3.5 2B Q4 passes one repetition in agent mode, Qwen 3.5 4B Q4 passes 3/5, and the Qwen 3.5 9B Q4 and 27B Q4 models pass 5/5. The improvement is not because T08 is conceptually easy in the agent-mode setting; it is because the required transformation is locally inspectable. An agent can open the JSON fixture, write a converter, execute it, inspect the generated CSV, and repair visible problems before submission.
paragraphs.zh: 可验证性与智能体增益。 任务层面的结果也表明，智能体增益在很大程度上取决于模型能否验证自身中间步骤的工作。 T08 是最清晰的正面例子。 该任务要求将一个维基数据风格的 JSON 快照转换为规范化的兴趣点 CSV 文件，包括坐标解析、标识符去重、备用标签以及固定的输出模式。 在 chat_only 模式下，没有任何模型能通过 T08（0/50 次尝试），而在 agent 模式下，有 37/50 次尝试成功。 即使是 Qwen 3.5 2B Q4 在 agent 模式下也能通过一次重复操作，Qwen 3.5 4B Q4 能通过 3/5 次，而 Qwen 3.5 9B Q4 和 27B Q4 模型则能全部通过（5/5）。 这种提升并非因为 T08 在 agent 模式设定下概念上容易；而是因为所需的转换过程可以在局部进行检验。 智能体可以打开 JSON 测试数据，编写转换器，执行它，检查生成的 CSV 文件，并在提交前修复显而易见的问题。

paragraphs.en: The traces that we inspected support this interpretation. Successful T08 agent runs tend to converge on the same workflow: inspect the actual JSON structure, preserve one output row per unique point-of-interest identifier, handle missing labels consistently, parse coordinates in the expected order, and check the generated file before submitting. Weaker models are less reliable because some repetitions still miss one of these invariants, but successful repetitions show that the feedback loop can compensate when the task exposes concrete, file-level evidence of correctness. In contrast, chat-only attempts cannot observe the fixture or execute the conversion, so they often assume a different JSON layout or produce outputs with invalid row counts or malformed fields. T08 therefore illustrates the setting in which tools provide the strongest benefit: bounded transformations with explicit artifacts and a cheap self-verification path.
paragraphs.zh: 我们检查的痕迹支持这种解释。 成功的 T08 智能体运行通常会收敛到相同的工作流程：检查实际的 JSON 结构，为每个唯一的兴趣点标识符保留一行输出，一致地处理缺失的标签，按预期的顺序解析坐标，并在提交前检查生成的文件。 较弱的模型可靠性较低，因为某些重复运行仍然会遗漏这些不变量之一；但成功的重复运行表明，当任务暴露出具体且位于文件层面的正确性证据时，反馈循环能够进行补偿。 相比之下，仅依赖聊天功能的尝试无法观察测试用例或执行转换，因此它们通常会假设不同的 JSON 布局，或生成具有无效行数或格式错误字段的输出。 因此，T08 展示了工具能带来最大效益的场景：具有明确产物且成本较低的自我验证路径的有限转换任务。

paragraphs.en: The harder part is that T01 lacks an equally direct local oracle for semantic adequacy. Reading the indicator file can confirm that a candidate identifier exists, but it does not by itself tell the model whether the selected set satisfies the intended mix of mobility and livability themes, analytical direction, and coverage constraints. The observed failures reflect this gap: some runs omit required themes, some produce malformed CSV structure, and others choose plausible but invalid indicators for the specified selection. Thus, the contrast between T08 and T01 clarifies the main mechanism behind heterogeneous agentic gain. The workspace condition helps most when the model can turn uncertainty into observable checks and repair artifacts from local evidence; it helps less when success depends on semantic grounding that cannot be fully verified through execution or file inspection.
paragraphs.zh: 更难的部分在于，T01 缺乏一个同样直接的本地神谕来判断语义充分性。 读取指标文件可以确认存在候选标识符，但仅凭这一点无法告诉模型，所选集合是否满足预期的移动性和宜居性主题组合、分析方向以及覆盖范围约束。 观察到的失败现象反映了这一差距：某些运行遗漏了必需的主题，某些生成了格式错误的 CSV 结构，还有一些则为指定选择选择了看似合理却无效的指标。 因此，T08 与 T01 之间的对比揭示了异质智能体增益背后的主要机制。 当模型能将不确定性转化为可观察的检查项，并基于本地证据修复产物时，工作区条件能发挥最大作用；而当成功依赖于无法通过执行或文件检查完全验证的语义基础时，这种帮助则相对有限。

paragraphs.en: Figure 5 presents failure categories by model. The smallest quantized models are dominated by protocol, schema, and loop failures in agent mode, indicating difficulty operating the tool interface. For larger models, protocol failures mostly disappear and logic errors become the main residual category. paragraphs.en: The controlled evaluation shows that local open-weight agents can produce valid artifacts for a substantial subset of the benchmark, but performance is neither uniform nor sufficient for unvalidated automation. paragraphs.en: The clearest answer to RQ1 is that the local workspace loop is the most important intervention in the benchmark, provided the model is capable enough to use the interface reliably. Among non-2B models, agent mode improves pass rate by 26.7 to 52.0 percentage points over chat-only mode, making it the largest observed performance shift across the evaluated conditions. The largest absolute gains occur in the middle of the capability range: Qwen 3.5 9B Q4 improves by 52.0 points, Qwen 3.5 9B BF16 by 50.7 points, and Qwen 3.5 4B BF16 by 45.3 points. For larger models, the percentage-point gain is smaller mainly because chat-only performance is higher, but it still reflects the value of the complete workspace loop. At the low end, the 2B models gain little because they do not have enough capability to follow the tool-calling protocol reliably.

paragraphs.en: The task-level results showed that agentic gain is much larger when the task is self-verifiable, meaning that the model can use local evidence to detect and repair its own mistakes before submission. T08 is the clearest positive case: no model solves it in chat-only mode, whereas agent mode solves 37/50 attempts. The task exposes concrete artifact-level checks, so the workspace loop can turn an initially uncertain transformation into an inspectable and repairable output. T01 shows the opposite boundary. Although the model can inspect the indicator-description fixture, there is no equally direct local oracle for whether a selected indicator set satisfies the intended semantic coverage and analytical-direction constraints. Agent mode helps somewhat overall on T01 (9/50 attempts versus 4/50 in chat-only), but several larger models still fail because the hard part is fixture-grounded domain judgment rather than executable transformation. Thus, the workspace interface is most valuable when tasks expose checkable intermediate states; it is less decisive when the core difficulty is open-ended semantic selection.
paragraphs.zh: 任务层面的结果表明，当任务具备自我验证性时，智能体带来的增益会大得多，这意味着模型可以利用局部证据在提交前检测并修正自身的错误。 T08 是最清晰的正面案例：没有任何模型能在纯聊天模式下解决该任务，而智能体模式则成功解决了 50 次尝试中的 37 次。 该任务暴露了具体的产物层面检查机制，因此工作区循环能够将最初不确定的转换过程转化为可检验且可修复的输出。 T01 展示了相反的情况边界。 尽管模型可以检查指标描述固定组件，但并没有同样直接的局部判断依据来确定所选指标集是否满足预期的语义覆盖范围和分析方向约束。 智能体模式在 T01 上整体表现有所提升（50 次尝试中成功 9 次，而纯聊天模式下仅为 4 次），但一些较大模型仍然失败，因为核心难题在于基于固定组件的领域判断，而非可执行的转换过程。 因此，当任务暴露出可检查的中间状态时，工作区接口的价值最大；而当核心困难是开放式的语义选择时，其决定性作用则较弱。

The 9B Q4 model reaches 69.3% and provides a compact comparison point, although its remaining failure rate still requires deterministic validation. Its approximately 6.5 GB checkpoint places validation-gated data-engineering assistance within the memory range of compact local hardware rather than only workstation-class 27B or 35B deployments. Larger local models still improve the frontier: Qwen 3.5 27B Q4 reaches 74.7%, Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B reaches 77.3%, Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B reaches 81.3%, and Qwen 3.6 27B dense reaches the best pass rate at 85.3%.

paragraphs.en: The failure taxonomy is consistent with this view: stronger local agents fail less often because of interface-level breakdowns and more often because of task-specific reasoning, validation, or fixture-grounding mistakes.
paragraphs.zh: 故障分类与此观点一致：更强大的本地智能体较少因接口层面的问题而失败，但更常因任务特定的推理、验证或夹具接地错误而失败。

paragraphs.en: The format-error pattern adds a useful nuance to this interpretation. Once a model can operate the workspace loop, the remaining failure mode is not always incorrect reasoning in the narrow sense; it can also be insufficient final validation of otherwise plausible artifacts. The Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B failures illustrate this point: several attempts reached submission with files or reports in the expected location, but the artifacts still violated parser-level or section-level requirements. In practice, this suggests that stronger local agents may benefit less from more raw tool access and more from explicit self-checking routines before submission, such as re-reading generated CSVs with the same library used downstream or verifying required report headings.

paragraphs.en: The efficiency results show that deployment decisions cannot be based on pass rate alone. Qwen 3.6 27B dense has the highest pass rate at 85.3%, but it also has the highest median submission time at 31.3s. sents.zh: MoE 模型在成果成功率与延迟关系图中占据了延迟效率更高的区域：Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B 在 9.6 秒时达到 77.3%，而 Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B 在 14.7 秒时达到 81.3%。

sents.en: The MoE configurations therefore show a practical wall-clock advantage in this local setting, although the design does not isolate architecture as its sole cause and the dense Qwen 3.6 27B remains the pass-rate leader.
sents.zh: 因此，在这种本地环境中，MoE 配置展现出实际运行时间的优势，尽管该设计并未将架构作为唯一原因进行隔离，且 Qwen 3.6 27B 稠密模型仍然是通过率最高的模型。

paragraphs.en: As previously mentioned, the 9B Q4 model is especially relevant for this deployment trade-off. Its pass rate is lower than the 27B and 35B-class models, but it reaches 69.3% while occupying roughly 6.5 GB and matching the MoE models in median submission time. This makes it a candidate for task-specific evaluation on compact machines or privacy-sensitive workflows where memory footprint and responsiveness matter alongside artifact correctness. In contrast, the larger models have higher pass rates but require a workstation-class GPU budget. The engineering choice is therefore a position on the artifact-success/latency/memory frontier rather than a single universally best model.
paragraphs.zh: 如前所述，9B Q4 模型对于此次部署权衡尤其具有相关性。 其通过率低于 27B 和 35B 级别的模型，但达到了 69.3%，同时仅占用约 6.5 GB 内存，且在中位数提交时间上与 MoE 模型相当。 这使得它成为在紧凑型设备或对隐私敏感的工作流程中进行任务特定评估的候选模型，在这些场景中，内存占用和响应速度与输出正确性同样重要。 相比之下，更大的模型虽然具有更高的通过率，但需要工作站级别的 GPU 资源支持。 因此，工程上的选择应基于在输出质量、延迟和内存之间的权衡，而非简单地选择某个单一的最佳通用模型。

paragraphs.en: The precision comparison shows that quantization is not uniformly harmful or harmless; its effect depends on where the base model sits relative to the capability threshold. BF16 does not rescue the 2B model, and it does not improve the 9B model, where Q4 is already slightly ahead within the sampling variability of five repetitions. At 4B, however, BF16 increases pass rate from 37.3% to 57.3%. The most plausible interpretation is that the 4B model lies close to the minimum capability boundary: losing precision pushes many attempts below the threshold for reliable parsing, tool use, and artifact construction, while BF16 gives enough headroom for more tasks to complete.
paragraphs.zh: 精度对比表明，量化并非一律有害或无害；其影响取决于基础模型相对于能力阈值的位置。 BF16 未能挽救 2B 模型，也未改善 9B 模型，而 Q4 在五次重复的采样波动范围内已略占优势。 然而，在 4B 模型上，BF16 将通过率从 37.3% 提高到了 57.3%。 最合理的解释是，4B 模型接近最低能力边界：精度的降低使许多尝试无法达到可靠解析、工具使用和产物构建所需的阈值，而 BF16 则提供了足够的余量，使更多任务能够完成。

paragraphs.en: Once the base model is sufficiently capable, Q4 quantization appears viable for this benchmark. The 9B Q4 model is more accurate, smaller and faster than the 4B BF16 model, and the best overall models in the sweep are quantized larger models served within the single-24 GB-GPU constraint. The 4B BF16 point still has practical value because it shows that precision can matter near the threshold, but it does not dominate the larger quantized alternatives. Within this benchmark, aggressive quantization is therefore not merely a mechanism for fitting larger models into memory; some quantized configurations retain substantial task performance. Broader claims require replication across model families, tasks, and quantization methods.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦基础模型的能力足够强，Q4 量化对于这项基准测试来说似乎就可行了。 9B Q4 模型比 4B BF16 模型更准确、体积更小且速度更快，而该轮测试中表现最佳的模型都是经过量化的较大模型，并在单块 24 GB GPU 的约束条件下运行。 4B BF16 模型仍然具有实际价值，因为它表明在接近阈值时精度可能很重要，但它并未优于更大规模的量化模型。 因此，在这项基准测试中，激进量化不仅仅是将更大模型装入内存的一种手段；某些量化配置仍能保持相当高的任务性能。 更广泛的结论需要跨不同模型家族、任务和量化方法进行验证。

paragraphs.en: The Qwen 3.5–3.6 comparison adds one final qualification. At the two matched sizes, Qwen 3.6 has higher point estimates: 85.3% versus 74.7% for 27B dense and 81.3% versus 77.3% for 35B-A3B. In this sweep, 9B Q4 is the first configuration to pass a majority of attempts, 35B-A3B offers the lowest latency among the higher-performing configurations, and Qwen 3.6 27B dense has the highest pass rate. Selection should nevertheless be based on representative tasks and jointly consider artifact correctness, latency, memory footprint, and protocol robustness.
paragraphs.zh: Qwen 3.5 与 3.6 的对比还需要补充一个最终限定条件。 在两个匹配的尺寸下，Qwen 3.6 的点估计值更高：27B 密集模型为 85.3% 对 74.7%，35B-A3B 模型为 81.3% 对 77.3%。 在这一轮测试中，9B Q4 是首个通过多数尝试的配置；35B-A3B 在高性能配置中延迟最低；而 Qwen 3.6 27B 密集模型的通过率最高。 尽管如此，选择仍应基于代表性任务，并综合考量成果的正确性、延迟、内存占用以及协议鲁棒性。

paragraphs.en: The controlled design supports consistent comparisons across the evaluated configurations, while the following considerations define the scope in which the findings should be interpreted.
paragraphs.zh: 受控设计支持对各个评估配置进行一致的比较，而以下考量则界定了这些发现应被解释的范围。

paragraphs.en: Construct validity. Artifact success captures the dimensions targeted by the benchmark, including execution, schema conformance, numerical consistency, report structure, and selected domain rules. This focus matches the study objective of assessing whether agents can deliver artifacts that satisfy explicit engineering requirements. It does not directly assess broader qualities such as maintainability, security, or subjective prose quality. Runtime and tool-call counts describe the tested harness and hardware.
paragraphs.zh: 构效度。 产物成功性涵盖了基准测试所针对的各个维度，包括执行、模式合规性、数值一致性、报告结构以及选定的领域规则。 这一重点与研究的客观目标一致，即评估智能体能否生成满足明确工程要求的产物。 它并未直接评估更广泛的质量特性，例如可维护性、安全性或主观的文本质量。 运行时和工具调用次数描述了受测的运行环境与硬件。

Five repetitions per cell capture recurring variability, although rare generation trajectories may not appear.

paragraphs.en: External validity. The controlled Qwen-family sweep, common serving stack, and single GPU support consistent within-study comparison. The fifteen tasks span five workflow stages and several artifact types, providing broader coverage than a single code-generation task. Results may nevertheless vary with other model families, agent designs, hardware, domains, and production-scale pipelines, which provides a natural direction for replication.

paragraphs.en: Conclusion validity. Aggregate rates combine tasks of different difficulty, and Wilson intervals summarize the observed attempts descriptively rather than supporting population-level inference. The matched Q4–BF16 comparison covers three model sizes and is therefore exploratory. We consequently emphasize effect sizes and task-level patterns. Repeated attempts and released traces complement the aggregate analysis, while the replication package supports broader follow-up studies.

paragraphs.en: This paper introduced a reproducible, artifact-level benchmark for evaluating local LLM agents as data-engineering assistants, using mobility workflows as a domain-grounded empirical testbed. Across 1,500 attempts, the evaluated configurations exhibited substantial differences in artifact correctness, interaction reliability, runtime, and failure behavior. The findings show that local agents can support parts of software-intensive data-engineering work, but they do not justify unvalidated autonomous execution.
paragraphs.zh: 本文提出了一项可复现的、基于成果物的基准测试，用于评估本地 LLM 智能体作为数据工程助理的能力，并以移动性工作流程作为贴近实际领域的经验性测试平台。 在 1,500 次尝试中，所评估的配置在成果物正确性、交互可靠性、运行时间和故障表现方面表现出显著差异。 研究结果表明，本地智能体可以支持软件密集型数据工程工作的部分环节，但这并不足以证明未经验证的自主执行是合理的。

paragraphs.en: The largest observed performance shift is associated with the complete workspace condition. Among non-2B models, pass rates are 26.7–52.0 percentage points higher than under one-shot generation. The comparison does not isolate tool access from iterative context or revision, but it demonstrates the engineering value of a configuration in which models can inspect files, execute code, observe errors, and repair artifacts. Gains are greatest when intermediate states are locally verifiable through parsers, executable scripts, numerical checks, or inspectable files.
paragraphs.zh: 观测到的最大性能变化与完整工作空间条件相关。 在非 2B 模型中，通过率比单次生成条件下高出 26.7–52.0 个百分点。 该比较并未将工具访问与迭代上下文或修订区分开来，但它展示了一种配置的工程价值：在这种配置下，模型可以检查文件、执行代码、观察错误并修复产物。 当中间状态能够通过解析器、可执行脚本、数值检查或可检查的文件进行本地验证时，性能提升最为显著。

paragraphs.en: The model sweep also identifies a resource–correctness trade-off. Qwen 3.6 27B dense attains the highest pass rate at 85.3%, while Qwen 3.5 9B Q4 reaches 69.3% with an approximately 6.5 GB checkpoint. The smaller configuration may be suitable for validation-gated assistance on constrained hardware, whereas the larger models reduce failures at higher memory or latency cost. None of the measured pass rates removes the need for task-specific checkers.

These observations are configuration-specific rather than general claims about architecture or quantization. More broadly, selecting an engineering agent requires evaluating artifact correctness together with latency, memory footprint, protocol reliability, and the availability of deterministic validation.

paragraphs.en: The benchmark and replication package provide a basis for extending this empirical evaluation to additional model families, agent scaffolds, hardware, and task suites. For software and data-engineering teams, the central implication is not that a particular local model is universally ready for deployment, but that complete agent configurations can be evaluated reproducibly through the artifacts they produce.
